hints.title: Component Connectedness
hints.text: The component consists of all cells sharing the original starting color reachable via 4-directional steps from (row, col).

hints.title: Border Identification
hints.text: A cell in the component belongs to the border if it sits on the grid perimeter or if at least one of its four orthogonal neighbors has a different color.

hints.title: Deferred Modification
hints.text: Collect all identified border coordinates in a separate list during traversal. Overwriting cell colors during traversal would disrupt subsequent neighbor checks.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Modifying cells immediately during traversal distorts component connectivity checks for neighboring cells.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Recording border cells into a list and applying paint in a second pass ensures linear time and safe updates.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should define border condition clearly and defer mutation until the component is identified.
complexity.notes: If starting color equals target color, matrix can be returned immediately.
